content.short: QuickNode Rollups provides rollup infrastructure for scalable blockchain apps.
content.description: QuickNode Rollups delivers scalable, dependable infrastructure for developers building blockchain apps that run on rollups. It offers solid support for leading rollup technologies, including the OP Stack, Arbitrum Orbit, and zk-Rollups, helping teams deploy high-traffic applications with reduced transaction costs and higher throughput. By managing backend operations and routing requests, it streamlines integration, accelerates development, and enables projects to scale efficiently without the burden of maintaining complex infrastructure.
